sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EAI.HANWHA_DEPT ( DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME, PARENT_DEPT_ID, PARENT_DEPT_NAME, ABBREVIATION, ACTION_YN, SORT_NO, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, CHILD_INC_YN, MANAGER_ID, SUBMANAGER_ID, DEPT_CODE ) VALUES ( #DEPT_ID#, #DEPT_NAME#, #PARENT_DEPT_ID#, #PARENT_DEPT_NAME#, #ABBREVIATION#, #ACTION_YN#, #SORT_NO#, #COMPANY_ID#, #COMPANY_NAME#, #CHILD_INC_YN#, #MANAGER_ID#, #SUBMANAGER_ID#, #DEPT_CODE# )
sqlMap.select: SELECT TEXT4 AS COMPANY_ID FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY TEXT4 ORDER BY 1

SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.COM_CODE IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT4 = #COMPANY_ID# AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY LEGACY_USER_ID

SELECT NVL(MANAGER_ID, SUBMANAGER_ID) AS MANAGER_ID FROM EAI.HANWHA_DEPT A WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT4 = #COMPANY_ID# AND FLAG = 'Y') AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = A.DEPT_ID ) AND ( MANAGER_ID IS NOT NULL OR SUBMANAGER_ID IS NOT NULL )
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO EAI.HANWHA_USER A USING ( SELECT #USER_ID# AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.ID = B.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET NAME = #USER_NAME_LOC#, DEPT_CODE = #DEPT_CODE#, DEPT_NAME = #DEPARTMENT#, EMP_NO = #EMP_NO#, PLANT = #PLANT#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE, IF_MSG = 'IF배치결과 반영' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ID, NAME, DEPT_CODE, DEPT_NAME, EMP_NO, PLANT, CREATE_DATE, IF_FLAG, IF_DATE, IF_MSG ) VALUES ( #USER_ID#, #USER_NAME_LOC#, #DEPT_CODE#, #DEPARTMENT#, #EMP_NO#, #PLANT#, SYSDATE, 'Y', SYSDATE, 'IF배치결과 반영' )
